text:
incident-bot: ALERT — Elevated error rate observed for Embeddings API (us-west-2). Incident channel created: <#incidents/1791234567>. severity: high. failing requests ≈ 38% across embedding endpoints.

laura_oncall: Ack. I'm taking first touch. Pulling logs and checking redis/worker queues.

nate_sre: Quick triage: redis embed-cache showing connection exhaustion + queue pileup on embed-worker-*. Some requests are timing out and returning 5xx. No signs of data exposure so far.

shawn_oncall: Drafting statuspage initial update — posting below for quick review. please comment fast.

shawn_oncall: ```
Initial status — Investigating (published 02:17 UTC)

We are investigating elevated error rates and timeouts for the Embeddings API in the US‑West (us-west-2) region. Some requests may return 5xx or timeouts. Impact: embedding generation and similarity search may fail or be delayed for customers routing to us-west-2.

What we're doing:
- Autoscaled embed-cache pool and restarted a subset of embed-worker instances.
- Routed a fraction of traffic to a healthy fallback pool to reduce user impact.

Customer impact:
- Partial service degradation for embeddings in us-west-2. Estimated affected requests: ~35–40%.

Next update: in 30 minutes or when we have new info.
```

maria_comm: Suggestion: add "no evidence of data exposure" explicit line, and call out the workaround customers can use (explicit region override). Also avoid technical verbs in the top line for customer-facing copy.

shawn_oncall: Updated draft with Maria's suggestions. New draft below (short customer-facing blurb) — please thumb if OK.

shawn_oncall: ```
Status (02:20 UTC) — We are investigating elevated error rates for the Embeddings API in US‑West (us-west-2). Some embedding requests may fail or be slower than normal.

Impact: Partial degradation for embedding generation and similarity queries in us-west-2.

Mitigation: Traffic partially routed to fallback pools and cache capacity increased. No evidence of data exposure.

Workaround: Customers can set region=us-east-1 or use Dedicated capacity if you need immediate failover.

We will post another update within 30 minutes.
```

eve_support: Can we get a short canned email/copy to send to affected customers? I have a queue of tickets hitting Support.

shawn_oncall: Posted canned support message below — use subject "Service degradation: Embeddings API (us-west-2)"

shawn_oncall: ```
Subject: Service degradation — Embeddings API (US‑West)

Hello —
We're investigating elevated error rates and timeouts for the Embeddings API in our US‑West region. Some embedding requests may fail or be delayed.

What we're doing: routing traffic to fallback pools and scaling cache capacity.

Workaround: You can direct requests to us-east-1 for lower latency during mitigation.

We apologize for the disruption. We'll update you within 30 minutes or when we have a resolution.

— Redwood Inference Status Team
```

maria_comm: +1 on the canned copy, small tweak suggestion: change "routing to fallback pools" -> "temporarily routing a portion of traffic to healthy capacity". Also add link to status page once published.

shawn_oncall: Got it. Applied wording change. @deploy-bot can you publish the first public update when I drop the final copy?

deploy-bot: Status page update queued. Publish command requires :publish.

shawn_oncall: /publish-statuspage 1791234567 — updating now.

deploy-bot: Status page update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1791234567 — initial update posted (02:27 UTC). :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Pager note: handoff scheduled — shawn_oncall will take the 02:00–06:00 UTC window for this incident. laura_oncall handing off now.

laura_oncall: Periodic update: error rate has dropped from ~38% to ~7% after scaling and routing changes. Background job backlog is draining; embedding worker restarts are holding. No evidence of data exposure. We'll keep monitoring for 2 hours.

nate_sre: Observability check: redis cmds/sec peaked at 9k -> 2.1k now, queue length down ~85%. Looks stable but still recovering for long-tail requests.

eve_support: Sending canned message to top 20 customers now (using updated wording). I'll CC @maria_comm on the ticket batch.

maria_comm: Approved for external comms. Please include status page link and short note that support will follow up if customers need help.

shawn_oncall: Drafting resolved notice. Proposing this copy:```
Resolved — 04:15 UTC

The Embeddings API in US‑West (us-west-2) has recovered. Error rates returned to normal after scaling embed-cache and draining worker queues. Root cause: connection exhaustion on embed-cache due to a mis-sized connection pool combined with a traffic spike.

Impact: Partial degradation of embedding generation and similarity searches in us-west-2 between 02:10–04:10 UTC. Affected requests peaked at ~40%.

Mitigation and next steps: We scaled cache instances, restarted affected workers, and applied a connection-pool limit fix. A postmortem will be published within 72 hours with corrective actions. No evidence of data exposure.

If you continue to see issues, please contact support: support@redwood.ai
```

maria_comm: small wording tweak, then publish.

shawn_oncall: /publish-statuspage 1791234567 resolved 1791241767

deploy-bot: Resolved update published: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1791234567#resolved — 04:18 UTC. :tada:

laura_oncall: Closing incident channel and filing postmortem ticket assigned to @nate_sre and @laura_oncall. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident closed and SLA window recorded.

shawn_oncall: Nice work everyone. Logging notes for postmortem: correlate client retries with queue backlog metrics and validate connection pool sizing defaults across all embed-cache clusters.

incident-bot: This thread will be archived.
